# Working preferences
The user prefers short answers with a runnable command first.
Always run the unit tests before proposing a commit.
Use uv for Python environments; never install packages globally.

# widget-detector: model notes
Detection confidence threshold is 0.35 for the conveyor camera.
The training set lives in data/widgets-v3 and has 4,200 labelled images.

## Evaluation
We report mAP@0.5 on the held-out shelf split.

# widget-detector: setup
Train with `uv run train.py --config configs/base.yaml`.
The camera stream is replayed from recordings/conveyor-sample.mp4 for local tests.

# orbit-planner: design
The planner schedules ground-station passes for a small satellite constellation.
Pass windows are computed with a two-line-element propagator every 6 hours.
Conflicts are resolved by priority: downlink > uplink > housekeeping.

# orbit-planner: todo
- Add a dry-run flag to the scheduler CLI.
- Write a regression test for overlapping pass windows.

# Shared tools
The team chat bot posts nightly build status at 07:00.
The plotting helper `plotkit` exports figures as SVG by default.
